title: About
text: Daniel Wei (any pronouns) is a postgender-identifying Chinese-American environmental analysis student at Pomona College in Claremont, California. Originally from Sandy Ridge Township, North Carolina, Daniel enjoys reading about current events, taking pictures, and enjoying the xeriscapes of Southern California.
